title: A nightly full CI run on main
description: Serves "Nothing breaks the viewers' evening.". Seen now: runner drift broke the queue until #285 repaired apt packages and e2e ports on newer runners. Runner image, browser and mirror drift show up today only in a change's merge-queue run. A scheduled run of the same jobs on main catches them off the merge path, once a day, and supplies timing and flake data.
acceptanceCriteria: A schedule trigger runs every CI job on main once a day, and test/changes.sh treats it as a full run
A failing nightly run opens or updates one issue naming the failed tests

The nightly run also runs, under the ffmpeg of the published image at its pinned version, the existing transcode integration checks whose result depends on ffmpeg: a restart's splice for a re-encode and for a copy, the tone map, a text and an image burn-in, and the read-ahead pause. No new check is written for it and it is never a required check of the merge queue: what an operator's viewers get is made by that ffmpeg, which the queue (6.1) does not run (D-069).
source: Fable 5.2 CI review, 2026-11-12 (.results/ci-review-2026-11-12.md); owner approved A, B, C, D and the later items
